Nivel de vechime: Nu se aplică
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software
As a Support Engineer, you will act as the main point of contact for production incidents and service requests, ensuring stable application operation, efficient incident management and clear communication with internal stakeholders and business users.
You will monitor platform health and data extraction performance, perform initial technical analysis, coordinate investigations with technical and specialist teams, and contribute to service reporting, documentation, maintenance and continuous improvement.
Key focus areas
Incident management and service requests.
Platform health, performance monitoring and reporting.
Initial technical diagnosis and coordinated escalation (Level 1 and Level 2 support).
Coordination of technical adjustments and configuration changes.
System availability, operational performance, maintenance and continuous improvement.
Act as the main point of contact for production incidents and service requests raised by business users and operational stakeholders.
Monitor platform health, service availability, processing status and performance indicators.
Perform initial issue analysis, collect relevant evidence, reproduce problems where possible and assess business and service impact.
Classify, prioritize, track and document incidents and service requests throughout their lifecycle.
Monitor incident and request resolution against agreed priorities, service levels and escalation timelines.
Resolve Level 1 and Level 2 issues within the agreed support scope and coordinate investigations with technical, development and specialist teams when additional expertise is required.
Ensure timely escalation to the appropriate technical experts and maintain ownership and follow-up until resolution.
Communicate incident status, workarounds, dependencies and resolution information clearly to relevant stakeholders.
Coordinate approved configuration, prompt and Python adjustments, performing limited changes within documented procedures and the agreed support scope.
Escalate changes requiring advanced technical expertise to the relevant specialists.
Validate implemented corrections and monitor post-resolution behaviour to confirm service recovery and data extraction quality.
Contribute to regular service reporting, including platform performance, incident trends, recurring issues and improvement actions.
Maintain support procedures, troubleshooting guides, known-error records, operational documentation and knowledge articles.
Identify recurring issues and propose preventive actions, automation opportunities and improvements to monitoring, alerting and support processes.
Support integrations, releases and onboarding of new document types from an operational-readiness perspective.
Participate in Agile ceremonies, backlog management and continuous-improvement activities.
Degree in Information Technology, Computer Engineering or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
At least 3 years of experience in application support, production support, technical operations, DevOps or a comparable role.
Experience supporting business-critical applications in a multi-team and international environment.
Good understanding of incident, problem, change and service-request management practices.
Ability to work in a structured manner during operational incidents, with strong ownership and clear stakeholder communication.
Fluency in English; another European language is an advantage.
Working knowledge of Python and SQL for investigation, validation and controlled technical adjustments.
Experience with application and platform monitoring, log analysis, alert handling and performance reporting.
Experience with ServiceNow for incident and request management.
Working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON payloads, HTTP status codes, asynchronous data processing workflows, batch execution and integration troubleshooting.
Knowledge of Git and CI/CD pipelines.
Knowledge of Jira for Agile backlog management and team collaboration.
Familiarity with OCR, document processing, data extraction or AI/ML-enabled applications is an advantage.
Knowledge of service-management principles; ITIL Foundation certification is an advantage.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail, customer orientation, collaboration, adaptability and delivery focus.
Competitive salary and the opportunity to have a meaningful job where you can make a difference
The chance to continuously evolve as a professional
Medical insurance & Meal tickets.
